title: ASML expects China to account for ~20% of total sales in 2026, after Q3 sales there surged 109% QoQ, lifting China's share of machine sales from 14% to 23% (Xiaofei Xu/South China Morning Post)
summary: Xiaofei Xu / South China Morning Post: ASML expects China to account for ~20% of total sales in 2026, after Q3 sales there surged 109% QoQ, lifting China's share of machine sales from 14% to 23% — Dutch semiconductor equipment giant ASML expects China to account for about 20 per cent of its total sales this year …
